environment.description: EKS cluster v1.28, pod deployed in 'catalog' namespace. Istio 1.20 sidecar injected but running in PERMISSIVE mTLS mode. No AuthorizationPolicy resources applied to the catalog namespace. Pod is reachable from any namespace via ClusterIP service on port 50051. NetworkPolicy not enforced (Calico not installed, using default aws-vpc-cni without policy enforcement).
